adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` when `safeParse` fails (`handleAdd`), but it is never set back to `false` on a successful validation or in `addGuestsMutation.onSuccess`. Only the Cancel button handler resets it (`setIsInvalidEmail(false)`). Since the dialog component stays mounted in `BookingListItem` and only toggles `open`, the `isInvalidEmail` state can persist across a successful add (dialog closes but state remains `true`) and will show the error banner again when reopened even though `multiEmailValue` was reset to `[""]`.
